name: humanizer-pro
description: Humanize AI-generated writing and strip AI-isms, in English and Arabic (MSA, Egyptian, Levantine).

interface.shortDescription: Make AI-generated writing read as human, in English and Arabic
interface.longDescription: Humanize AI-generated writing and strip AI-isms, in English and Arabic. Three modes: detect (audit plus 0-100 score), rewrite, and edit (in-place edits to a prose file), plus an seo modifier that protects keywords, headings, links, anchor text, schema and CMS markup. Arabic covers MSA, Egyptian, and Levantine (experimental) with automatic variety detection.
defaultPrompt: Humanize this draft and remove AI tells without changing its meaning
Detect whether this text reads as AI-generated and score it
Rewrite this article to sound human while keeping its SEO markup intact
